issues.title: Modernize for PyPI: package rename, CI/CD, uv examples
issues.body:
## Summary
- Reorganize source files by function (pybind, geometry, planning, plant, utils)
- Rename package `pycsdecomp` → `csdecomp` (import name matches PyPI distribution)
- Add CI workflow (lint + build on every push) and wheel build workflow (Python 3.10/3.11/3.12, manylinux_2_28)
- Modernize examples: Poetry → uv, add Bazel test targets so `bazel test //...` covers everything
- Fix bug in `plan_DRM.py` (missing `plant_context` argument)
- Clean up stale files, update all documentation

## Test plan
- [x] `bazel test //...` passes locally (44 tests including 3 new example tests)
- [x] CI green on `pypi` branch (lint + build)
- [ ] Trigger `build-wheels.yml` after merge to verify wheel builds for all Python versions
- [ ] Test wheel install + `import csdecomp` from built artifacts

findings.applicability: Not a demonstrated runtime fault in this environment: installed official PyPI wheel is used, no Bazel rebuild initiated. The official workaround is explicit CUDA toolkit_path. Do not modify a working Conda environment to treat an unrelated native Drake crash.

findings.description: DRM _plan must return 0 when PlanStatePath fails instead of falling through. Exact merged return is present.
Disconnected kinematic ancestry checked before indexing parent_joint -1.

Drake bridge receives plant_context and handles locked joints by converting them to fixed transforms. Benchmark supplies explicit context; canonical model checks exact joint order, count, limits, primitive inventory and collision pair identities.

Package modernisation and missing plant_context example fix. Benchmark does not invoke a missing/obsolete plan_DRM.py example. Current Kinova example and canonical Model both provide plant_context; installed package is csdecomp.

Upstream build_DRM.py uses simple_kinova_sens_on_table.yml while kinova_mintime_planning.py uses kinova_sens_on_table.yml. Existing benchmark builder and all runners use canonical Model based on full kinova_sens_on_table.yml; roadmap and manifest robot/geometry hashes are checked before planning. No model or radius change is justified.

Native Voxels is float32 column-major 3 x N, configuration matrix is joints x states. Canonical Model validates finite Nx3 points, quantizes centers once to float32, passes transposed3xN points and transposed7xN states. Independent checker uses exactly those centers and fixed .04m radius.

Default evaluation selects consistent_query portable host sidecar. Original official C++/CUDA source and installed wheel remain unchanged. Reviewed CPU source repairs include failure exit handling, endpoint-local edge exclusions, endpoint-inclusive steering, same-node reachability, query cache reconciliation and alternate bounded endpoint attachments; retained build receipt binds all native headers, source, binary and installed library hashes. Source correction guards reject unreviewed upstream drift.

Builder uses saved PCG64 configurations via add_nodes_manual; scene/query RNGs are separate. Online EI-ZO sets native EizoOptions.seed from planner_seed and creates a per-query planner/inflator while canonical plant, minimal plant and voxel wrapper remain alive during native calls. No seed or borrowed-object-lifetime violation found by source review. This is not a proof of absence of native concurrency faults.

Complete issues(all states) and PR listing reviewed: 1 issue and 8 merged PRs at capture time, no matching libdrake SIGSEGV runtime report. Historical crash occurred in libdrake during NTO; official CSDecomp wheel identity cannot establish its root cause. Preserve infrastructure_error and investigate Drake/solver separately; do not claim a CSDecomp upgrade fixes it.

changes_applied: No runtime/environment/model changes by this sub-audit. Existing explicit host fixes already present; official source and installed wheel verified unchanged.
limitations: No GPU calls performed by this sub-audit. Parent carries out integration regressions.
Source checks and finite regression tests cannot prove universal bug absence.
Official repository API state captured at a time, not a claim about unpublished author fixes.

cpu_regressions.scope: CPU source drift, wrapper protocol, and historical native float32 anchor handoff regression; no GPU planner

review_comment_completeness.note: All 8 PR review and inline comment endpoints checked, per_page100; no endpoint reached pagination limit.
